svg.title: CMU ARLO PostgreSQL Database ERD
svg.desc: Landscape, high-definition entity relationship diagram generated from the live PostgreSQL schema.
svg.text: Landscape HD physical ERD generated from cmu_arlo_db on June 5, 2026 8:22 PM
21 tables | 274 columns | 17 physical foreign keys | PostgreSQL connection: pgsql
Designed for adviser review: grouped by system module, with full column lists, row counts, primary keys, unique keys, foreign keys, defaults, and logical notification links.

g.text: Each column shows: name : PostgreSQL type nullability = default. Hover an SVG row for full defaults and key details.
Alumni accounts, staff accounts, roles, permissions, sign-in sessions, and password reset support.
Graduate profile linkage, tracer submissions, employment status, survey answers, and proof review fields.
Admin job board records and alumni-submitted job opportunities awaiting review or rejection reason.
Published notices, read tracking, in-system notifications, and alumni support tickets.
System activity logs plus Laravel operational tables used by cache, queues, migrations, and failures.

g.text: One alumni user can have many tracer_records. The table stores employment status, employer, ratings, survey answers, proof upload metadata, and proof review fields.
The unique tracer_number identifies a submitted tracer snapshot. user_id keeps each tracer entry tied to the graduate account.
notifications uses Laravel's polymorphic notifiable_type and notifiable_id, so it can notify alumni, admins, or super admins without a physical FK.
Rejected job submissions notify the alumni in-system and by email, with the rejection reason stored in job_submissions.admin_notes and notification data.
